query: 78-year-old man: among male patients 73–83 years at first hospital admission, what is the 25th percentile of in-hospital mortality?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY p.dod) AS q25 FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) = 2017 AND p.anchor_year BETWEEN 73 AND 83;
